context: Industrial Water Telemetry and Digital Twin Early-Warning Platform for Commercial Enterprises & Public Utilities in South Africa

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_spacing.mode: High Density Precision Grid (SCADA / Command Center Style)
layout_and_spacing.header_nav: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 z-50
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Cardless or sharp 1px border container with rounded-md bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-800 p-5 shadow-inner opacity-95 hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons, rows, node cards have explicit transition-all duration-200 with hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white
motion_and_interactions.realtime_pulse: Live stream indicator pulsing green dot (animate-pulse) or flashing red badge on burst detection

accessibility.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY on all interactive buttons, inputs, tables, select boxes, tabs, simulator controls, and node detail links in kebab-case format.
accessibility.hover_text_contrast: Always explicitly define hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-slate-950).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-performance industrial telemetry & Digital Twin early warning dashboard named AmanziAlert.
Target environment: Dark mode Command Center (#070B12 background, #0F172A surfaces, #00E5FF cyan electric highlights).

Use Recharts or Lucide/Shadcn charts for rendering telemetry streams (Pressure bar, Flow m3/h, Reservoir %, Pump power kW) with shaded baseline tolerance bands representing Digital Twin expected values.
Display financial water loss in ZAR (South African Rand) dynamically calculated based on water loss m3/h * tariff ZAR/kL.
Provide demo Scenario Simulator (Pipe Burst, Micro Leak, Pump Trip) that injects realistic anomalies into the realtime telemetry stream and triggers Sonner toasts + incident generation.
Include org settings for tariff configuration and load shedding stage alert toggles.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain white backgrounds for this industrial IoT dashboard.
DO NOT use forbidden font 'space grotesk' or forbidden colors (#1B93A4 or #7351B7). Use Outfit/IBM Plex Sans with Cyan/Amber/Red accents.
Add data-testid to every button, modal input, tab, select item, and row action.
Use sonner for realtime alert toasts (Pipe Burst, Pump Trip, Micro Leak warnings).
